items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: my grandfather was a music lover. His name was Warren too.

ctx.x: This piano behind you has followed you around?

It was my grandfather’s. It’s the reason I’m here. Oh that’s another story, that goes way back. My mother talked her father into buying a piano so that Larry Bernhardt would come over and play the piano for them because my grandfather was a music lover. His name was Warren too. And so that was her thing. And then she said, “Can I take music lessons with Larry?” And I think they worked on one Chopin prelude, that was it, and then they were married soon thereafter. So this piano is a present, and I inherited it…
